title: External access to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Starting on or after December 10, 2026, external access to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables will be available by default for eligible workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

Supported external Delta clients can create, read, and write Unity Catalog managed Delta tables. Creating and writing managed Delta tables requires [catalog commits](/aws/en/tables/features/catalog-commits). Metastore external data access settings and Unity Catalog privileges continue to control access.

See [Access Databricks tables from Delta clients](/aws/en/external-access/unity-rest).

ref_links.text: Access Databricks tables from Delta clients
